title: Ephraim Salzberg
summary: Remembered as the writer's friend; also identified as the son of Jehiel.

enrichment.markdown:
**Ephraim Salzberg (Efraim Zaltsberg)** — The Chmielnik memorial-book necrology includes an Efraim Zaltsberg alongside Esther, Meir and Yechiel. That cluster may be family, but the list does not define the relationships, so it cannot establish whether these are the same Ephraim or identify his father Jehiel with certainty. I found no independently corroborating record for Ephraim under Salzberg, Zaltsberg or Efraim in the archives searched; dates, migration and fate remain unverified. [Chmielnik necrology](https://www.jewishgen.org/yizkor/chmielnik/chm0017.html)

**Rachel Steinfeld and her family** — The Chmielnik necrology separately lists Rachel (Rachele) Steinfeld with Blimele, Chaya’le, Devora’le and Avraham’le; it also names Shimon-Eliezer Steinfeld with Rachel and Reizele, and Baruch-Yitschak with Blimele, Avraham’le and Chaya’le. These entries show several Steinfeld households and overlapping given names, but do not establish that they are one family or connect them to Ephraim. [Chmielnik necrology](https://www.jewishgen.org/yizkor/chmielnik/chm0017.html)

A separate Zawiercie memorial-book entry names Shmuel Eliezer Steinfeld and Freda, their sister Ruchtshe, and surviving relatives. The similar name is not enough to identify him as the Chmielnik Shimon-Eliezer; the place and family details differ, so this is a possible namesake, not a confirmed connection. [Zawiercie memorial book](https://www.jewishgen.org/Yizkor/Zawiercie/zaw571.html)

**Blima, Haya, Deborah, Abraham and the other listed names** — Blima, Haya, Deborah and Abraham may correspond to the diminutive forms Blimele, Chaya’le, Devora’le and Avraham’le in the Chmielnik list. The source supplies no individual dates, spouses or fates for them. The additional names Shimon-Eliezer, Abraham-Tzvi, Rakhil, Baruch-Yitzhak, Abraham’le, Reizele and Blima’le likewise cannot be securely matched beyond the Steinfeld entries above; some may be repeated family names, and the necrology alone does not resolve identities. [Chmielnik necrology](https://www.jewishgen.org/yizkor/chmielnik/chm0017.html)

**Archive checks** — Searches included JewishGen’s Chmielnik necrology and its Kielce-district survivor list, plus searches targeted at Yad Vashem, USHMM and Arolsen for Ephraim/Efraim Salzberg/Zaltsberg and Steinfeld spellings. The survivor list identifies Chmielnik as a locality with 69 listed survivors, but the accessible result did not supply a person-level match for this family. An Arolsen result for Chaim Salzberg of Kielce is a different given name and birthplace, so it is not evidence about Ephraim. [Kielce survivor-list description](https://www.jewishgen.org/databases/Holocaust/0070_SurvivorsKielce.html) · [Arolsen record for Chaim Salzberg](https://collections.arolsen-archives.org/en/document/79689332)
